label: Kanno et al. (2006)
units: PGA, SA in g at the API boundary; the model's own units and log base are kept under parameters
validityScope: Single-site intensity only; no spatial correlation, so never use it to draw a correlated field across multiple assets. Valid only inside its own published magnitude, distance, period and damping envelope, recorded under parameters; outside it the wrapper refuses unless the caller sets allow_extrapolation. Not usable at version 0.1.0: coefficients are anchor_only - one anchor branch (PGA, both depth branches) is reproducible from the specification appendix, but the spectral table and a median kernel are not in the repository - so construction raises CoefficientsUnavailable and no capability is declared. What is missing is named under parameters.coefficients.needed.

source.catalogue: Douglas, J. (2011). Ground-motion prediction equations 1964-2010. PEER Report 2011/102 / BRGM/RP-59356-FR.
source.benchmark_spec: gmpe_30_coding_prompts.md, sections 3 and 4 - the 30-family benchmark set definition.
source.caveat: Douglas (2011) is a catalogue, not a ranking, and warns that a report of its size may contain errors or omissions. Every envelope below is its summary, frequently approximate. Nothing here substitutes for the original publication.
source.coefficient_appendix: gmpe_30_coding_prompts_with_coefficients.md sections 11 and 12 - coefficients transcribed from Douglas (2011), with an explicit per-model completeness status and a coefficient-completeness gate.

parameters.label: Kanno et al. (2006)

site.correction: log(obs/pre) = p*log(Vs30) + q, applied AFTER the reference prediction
site.anchor_note: The Vs30 correction G = p*log(Vs30) + q is published for PGA as p = -0.55, q = 1.35.

mechanism.anchor_note: Neither depth branch carries a mechanism term in the anchor.

depth_branch.rule: One published equation for D <= 30 km, another for D > 30 km.
depth_branch.warning: This is a DEPTH branch, not a tectonic-type branch. Do not infer tectonic type from it.

coefficients.needed: The SPECTRAL period tables for both depth branches and the period-dependent p/q. PGA values for D<=30 km (a1 0.56, b1 -0.0031, c1 0.26, d1 0.0055) and D>30 km (a2 0.41, b2 -0.0039, c2 1.56) plus PGA p/q are now available.

implementation_notes: Do not smooth the 30 km depth transition unless the original source does.
Test immediately below, at, and above 30 km.
parameters.reason_for_inclusion: Explicit shallow/deep formulation and Vs30 correction.

aleatory.note: A single total sigma per depth branch; no tau/phi split in the anchor.

resolution_provenance.component: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/kanno_2006.py quotes the paper (p. 880): 'The peak value is the peak square root of the sum of squares of two orthogonal horizontal components in the time domain' (IMC.PEAK_SRSS_HORIZONTAL). Consistent with Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table) component code R.
resolution_provenance.periods.grid: OpenQuake hazardlib (gem/oq-engine master, retrieved 2026-10-04), openquake/hazardlib/gsim/kanno_2006.py coefficient table; period count and range (37 periods, 0.05-5 s) match Douglas (2011) BRGM/RP-59356-FR, Illustration 2 (spectral characteristics table). External implementation, original paper not checked.
